section-197-1.TO: by order amend this Act to provide that any of the following does not contravene this Act so far as relating to age— (a) specified conduct; (b) anything done for a specified purpose; (c) anything done in pursuance of arrangements of a specified description

section-197-3.TO: — (a) confer on a Minister of the Crown or the Treasury a power to issue guidance about the operation of the order (including, in particular, guidance about the steps that may be taken by persons wishing to rely on an exception provided for by the order); (b) require the Minister or the Treasury to carry out consultation before issuing guidance under a power conferred by virtue of paragraph (a); (c) make provision (including provision to impose a requirement) that refers to guidance issued under a power conferred by virtue of paragraph (a)

section-197-5.TO: For the purposes of satisfying a requirement imposed by virtue of subsection (3)(b), rely on consultation carried out
section-197-5.BEFORE: the making of the order that imposes the requirement (including consultation carried out before the commencement of this section)

section-197-6.TO: refer to provisions of the guidance that themselves refer to a document specified in the guidance
